description: Schema for bench/results/<machine-id>/machine.json. One per machine; stable across benchmark runs. Forward-compatible: unknown keys ignored.

compiler.description: Compiler used for the benchmarked build, e.g. 'gcc-13.2.0'.

brand.description: CPUID brand string, e.g. 'AMD EPYC 9D25 128-Core Processor'.

features.description: ISA feature flags as detected by rj_cpu_detect (feature names, lowercase).

rvv_vlen_bytes.description: RVV VLEN in bytes; 0 if no RVV.

notes.description: Free-form: VM vs bare metal, noisy neighbors, frequency governor, etc.

registered.description: UTC date the machine was registered (RFC 3339).

title: raidjit benchmark machine descriptor
